name: Ammonia and urea
principle: Natural gas or other feed is reformed to hydrogen, nitrogen is added and ammonia is made over iron catalyst in a Haber-Bosch loop; ammonia and CO2 then react in a urea synthesis reactor. Stamicarbon's CO2 stripping process cut steam use from 1,600 to 1,800 kg/t urea in conventional plants to about 800 kg/t, and its N=3 pool-condenser concept runs at 400 t/d in Geleen and 2,100 t/d at Bontang, Indonesia.

performance.metric: steam per tonne urea, conventional versus CO2 stripping
performance.basis: conventional 1,600 to 1,800; N=2 stripping about 800 at 25 bar; N=3 596 to 610 MP steam

source.note: IFA technical conference paper (Jonckers), urea stripping processes, 2000
